purpose: Deterministic RPS-02/SymRella scenarios covering thermal edge cases, cervical interpretation blocking, double-check states, data integrity and tutor safety.

scenarios.description: Six usable reference values followed by values that remain below or at the reference.
First three higher values exist but the third is below reference plus 0.20 C.
Three higher values with the third at or above reference plus 0.20 C.
Fourth higher value completes a rise when the third does not reach plus 0.20 C.
One ignored low/on-line value occurs between qualifying higher values.
Two low/on-line interruptions prevent the single-low exception.
Fewer than six usable temperatures are available.
A missing temperature is not converted into a synthetic low value.
A disturbed value inside the low reference series is excluded while raw data remain preserved.
All apparent higher values are marked disturbed and therefore cannot qualify.
A disturbed value after an already confirmed shift does not erase the confirmed result.
Fahrenheit input is converted before thermal evaluation.
Import/export round trip produces the same evaluation.
Editing a historical temperature changes the evaluation deterministically.
Deleting a qualifying temperature removes the confirmation when no alternative exists.
No cervical observation is supplied.
Current UI labels are retained as raw observations without manufacturing a Peak.
Three calendar days of cervical observations do not create Peak plus three automatically.
Contradictory cervical sequence remains descriptive.
Raw metadata such as sensation, appearance, amount and source is preserved.
Thermal criterion complete but cervical criterion pending.
Cervical criterion complete in a test fixture but thermal criterion pending.
Both criteria complete; completion date is the later criterion.
Tutor messages remain descriptive and do not claim ovulation, diagnosis or contraceptive safety.
Tutor language changes wording only; engine state is language-independent.
Personal photo support remains a local preview and is not persisted by the RPS-02 workshop.
External pilot references are not treated as production-local assets until rights, integrity and mirroring checks are complete.
No cervical mapping is promoted to a SymRella rule without independent annotation and methodological review.
